Use this prompt to run the migration demo. Read the `migrate-react-to-astro` skill from
`.github/skills/migrate-react-to-astro/SKILL.md` before doing anything else and follow every
step in order.

Pass along any arguments given to this prompt as a conversion-unit filter (e.g. `M1 M3`
migrates only those two); if none are given, migrate every unit in `docs/migration-plan.md`.
